remarks:
Hidden from view on 120 beautiful acres, this extraordinary country estate offers exceptional privacy, recreation, and energy independence. A 1,000' private driveway leads to a picturesque 2002 farmhouse-style residence surrounded by mature trees, landscaping, and stone-edged gardens. A spacious covered porch overlooks a scenic pond, creating a peaceful setting for country living.
The 2,816 sq. ft. home features an inviting open floor plan, 5 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, an office, and additional storage. A beautifully updated country kitchen showcases Shaker-style cabinetry, stone countertops, a large island, stainless appliances, double wall ovens, tile backsplash, and a generous walk-in pantry with a second refrigerator. Multiple heating sources, including radiant heat, and a durable metal roof complement the home's thoughtful design.

An impressive collection of outbuildings provides exceptional versatility, including a 68' x 45' shop, 100' x 72' long barn, 85' x 44' pole barn, and 40' x 40' smaller barn. Additional improvements include a greenhouse, chicken coop, and camp. Ideal for equipment, ATVs, campers, workshops, agricultural pursuits, and hobby farming.
Explore 120 acres featuring 9 ponds with a water-level management system, established ATV and walking trails, wildlife food plots, gardens, fruit orchards, and excellent deer and turkey hunting opportunities. The diverse landscape offers recreation, wildlife habitat, and room to enjoy the outdoors.
An extensive solar energy system supports the home and outbuildings, complemented by a whole-house generator, private well, septic, and multiple heating sources for reduced utility expenses and greater independence. Gas, mineral, and oil rights convey, with no gas well on the property.
A truly remarkable private country retreat offering the freedom to live, work, explore, and enjoy an exceptional rural lifestyle!
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: GMO’s convey, Residence with three large outbuildings, a barn, greenhouse, camp, orchards, nine ponds, exceptional privacy and deer hunting. Well, Septic, electric, Solar, LP gas,  Tesla Charger, Dog training run, 7.2 miles to Medina, 12.4 miles to Albion
